IV. 2. 67.</ls>] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a region abounding in Udumbara trees. .²2 A form of Yama, the god of death. .²3 Made of copper. .²4 A class of ascetics solely living on whatever fruits they see first early in the morning; <ls>Bhāg. 3. 12. 43</ls>. .{@-री@} A branch of the Udumbara tree. .{@-रम्@} .²1 The wood of the Udumbara tree. .²2 The Udumbara fruit. .²3 A kind of leprosy. .²4 Copper or a copper-vessel; <ls>Mb. 5. 40. 10</ls>.
